notable_features.text: Russian is a Slavic language with a large phoneme inventory of 42 sounds and marks seven distinct tense/aspect categories, reflecting its rich system of grammatical aspect alongside tense. It follows a basic SVO word order but, like other Slavic languages, allows flexibility due to its case-marking morphology. Historically tied to the Soviet Union, it continues to serve as a lingua franca across much of Eastern Europe, the Caucasus, and Central Asia.
